Slides is a place for creating, presenting and sharing slide decks.

It runs in the cloud and is available wherever you are. Even on your phone.

Let us show you how Slides helps you make better presentations.

Create

Drag to select multiple blocks at once.

Slide layout is precise and flexible without sacrificing ease-of-use.

The media library makes it easy to reuse and organize uploaded assets.

There's a built-in library of shapes and symbols to extend your visual language.

Custom templates can be saved in the User tab.

Speed up your workflow with slide templates.

You can present live to an audience anywhere on the globe.

When you change slides, they follow.

Use your mobile phone as a remote control. Simply tap or swipe to change slides.

Teams

The Team plan streamlines your team's presentation workflow.

 

It lets you provide easy access to the assets your teammates need in order to efficiently and quickly create presentations.

Images, videos and slide templates can be shared with all of your team.

The theme editor lets you create custom presentation themes.

All team members have access to these themes and you can pick which one that should be used by default.

Team analytics gives you insight into which presentations that are performing well across the whole team.

Invite teammates to collaborate on your presentations. Learn more.

Teams get a custom subdomain, like team.slides.com, where all Slides branding can be replaced with your own.

Why should my team use Slides?

1. Productivity

Since Slides runs in the cloud your team can get going in no time, from anywhere.

In-editor access to shared assets reduces friction and allows everyone to work more efficiently.

2. Brand Consistency

Ensure that your team always adheres to branding guidelines by creating custom presentation themes.

Your team accesses Slides through a white labeled subdomain.

3. Collaboration

The team homepage lets you keep up with what your team is working on.

Teammates can easily work together, leave feedback and even reuse each others decks.

Slides is a subscription service, billed either monthly or annually. Teams pay based on how many members that are added.
